examCheckpoints.label: Exam checkpoints
examCheckpoints.description: Share of checkpoints reached in the race exam (all races together). Higher is better.

examFinished.label: Exam races finished
examFinished.description: Share of races finished in the race exam.

heldOutSuccess.label: Held-out targets reached
heldOutSuccess.description: Fixed held-out scenarios at the hardest curriculum level: share of targets reached by the winner.

exam.label: Exam score
exam.description: Race exam score: 1000 per missed checkpoint + seconds + distance left (lower is better). Sums over races, so compare equal exam sizes only.

examCrashes.label: Exam crashes
examCrashes.description: Crashes in the race exam, all races together.

heldOut.label: Held-out score
heldOut.description: Score on the fixed held-out scenarios at the hardest level (lower is better).

success.label: Training success
success.description: Share of targets the winner reached in this generation's scenarios and level.

score.label: Training winner score
score.description: The winner's score. Scenarios change every generation, so this is not a progress measure.

reevalScore.label: Re-eval score
reevalScore.description: Re-evaluation: the winner's score on the extra scenarios.

reevalSuccess.label: Re-eval success
reevalSuccess.description: Re-evaluation: the winner's share of targets on the extra scenarios.

level.label: Curriculum level
level.description: Curriculum level flown in the generation (0 = easiest).

examRobust.label: Robust exam score
examRobust.description: Robustness exam score: the same races with input delay and noise (lower is better).

examRobustCheckpoints.label: Robust exam checkpoints
examRobustCheckpoints.description: Robustness exam: share of checkpoints reached.

examRobustFinished.label: Robust exam finished
examRobustFinished.description: Robustness exam: share of races finished.

examRobustCrashes.label: Robust exam crashes
examRobustCrashes.description: Robustness exam: crashes, all races together.

sigma.label: Mutation sigma
sigma.description: Mutation sigma: scheduled, or the winner's self-adaptive sigma.

tps.label: Ticks per second
tps.description: Game ticks simulated per second. Timing only, not a result.

ticks.label: Ticks per generation
ticks.description: Game ticks simulated in the generation. Timing only.

shipStepsPerSec.label: Ship-steps per second
shipStepsPerSec.description: Moving ships x frames per second: the real simulation work. Timing only.

shipSteps.label: Ship-steps per generation
shipSteps.description: Ship-steps simulated in the generation. Timing only.

spin.label: Winner spin
spin.description: Mean |turn output| of the winner (1 = always turning at full rate).
